title: Order tracking on a run-up
line: A 4-cylinder's orders, resampled to shaft angle.
description: A 4-cylinder run-up from 1,000 to 6,000 rpm: the vibration signal resampled to shaft angle, so the engine orders stand still in the spectrum.
thumbnailAlt: Order spectrum of a 4-cylinder run-up with the second order dominant, rendered by RunMat
